title: Web Design Doha: Bilingual Websites | The Brandle
description: Web design for Doha businesses. Bilingual Arabic and English websites and stores, local card payments set up properly, and no VAT to complicate checkout.

hub.name: Web design Doha
hub.line: Marble lobby energy, for your homepage.

hero.joke: Doha does its hotel lobbies in marble. A lot of its websites are still done in plasterboard.
hero.intro: Web design for Doha, from a studio in Dubai. Bilingual Arabic and English websites and online stores for hospitality, property, professional services and retail, with the payment methods people in Qatar actually use and a checkout with no VAT line to argue about.

items.p: Arabic and English designed together, each in its own direction, so neither one looks like an afterthought.
NAPS debit cards, Visa, Mastercard and Apple Pay, through a gateway licensed to take payments in Qatar.
Qatar doesn't charge VAT, so prices stay clean. If that ever changes, the store is set up to add a tax line without a rebuild.
Rooms, residences, menus and enquiry forms laid out for people choosing between several very nice options.
Clear structure for a mixed audience, with the language switch where people look for it, not hidden in the footer.
Light pages that load fast on mobile and are tested on real phones.

fit.p: Doha clients often need a site that impresses the people who live here and the people who just arrived. That means two languages done properly, payments that work with local cards and a structure a visitor can follow without a guide.
yes: A Doha business that needs both Arabic and English
A hotel, restaurant or property developer
A professional firm with a site that undersells it
A Gulf brand opening in Qatar
fit.no: you're a large organisation buying through several committees. [Web design Abu Dhabi](/services/web-design-abu-dhabi/) describes how we run those projects. For checkout only, see [payment gateway integration](/services/payment-gateway-integration/).

items.p: A free video call. Doha is one hour behind Dubai, so mornings suit both sides. A written scope and fixed quote follow.
Key pages designed in Arabic and English side by side.
Built on the platform that suits you, with payments connected in test mode. Our weeks overlap Monday to Thursday.
Test payments with local cards, both languages checked, then live. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Our fixed plans run from $1,299 to $6,499, and a site or store takes 3 to 6 weeks. A second language and a Qatar payment gateway add scope, which the quote will show. Translation is separate.

tools.note: Payment methods we can connect through a gateway that supports them. Mostly written as words, because that's how their owners prefer it.

faq.q: Is there VAT on online sales in Qatar?
faq.a: Not at the moment. Qatar doesn't charge VAT, so your prices can stay as they are. We still build the store so a tax line can be switched on later if the rules change.

faq.q: Which payment methods should a Doha store take?
faq.a: Local NAPS debit cards, Visa, Mastercard and Apple Pay, through a gateway licensed in Qatar. Cash on delivery is still worth offering for many shops.

faq.q: Can you work with us from Dubai?
faq.a: Yes. Doha is one hour behind Dubai. Your week runs Sunday to Thursday and ours Monday to Friday, so four days overlap. We reply within one business day.
We design for it and can recommend translators. Native copy is a specialist's job, and we won't run your brand through a translation tool and hope.
